maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from propane fuel delivery and refills, a consumable used up in use, plus tank exchange; not repair work.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are households and businesses buying propane for heating and fuel, paid privately.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through retail propane delivery and tank exchange; recent years show few acquisitions, mostly organic and cost-focused.

mission_critical.reason: Propane is a commodity fuel; customers can switch suppliers, though tank ownership adds some friction.

notes: Tank ownership and heating dependence add some switching friction, but propane suppliers are largely interchangeable.
